intro: Burkina Faso is a landlocked country of savanna and the dry Sahel, crossed by the Volta rivers.

chapters.title: Land
text: The country is mostly a flat plateau. The Black, Red and White Volta rivers flow south into Ghana. The south-west has the Sindou Peaks and the Karfiguéla waterfalls.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The north is dry Sahel; most rain falls between June and September.

keyTerms.meaning: The dry belt south of the Sahara.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Burkina Faso's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
